question: Wash wa3d, sarf, w-nata2ij dyal programme i3mar l-Houz 2024-2028 kaytla9aw b-wodo7 men l-budget l-dar w-l-khadma li wslat l-kol qarya?
claims: Official programme claim: envelope dyal 120 milyar dirham 3la 2024-2028 kayghatti 4.2 million sakn f-6 a9alim; had ra9m programme multi-sector, ma-shi sarf monjaz.

World Bank financing claim: $1 billion Program-for-Results kaysaned recovery/resilience w-kayrbet financing b-results; exact disbursement and verified indicators khas-hom extract men implementation reports.
Residents' claim reported independently: ba3d l-motaḍarririn f-High Atlas chtkaw men ta2akhkhur w-sokon mo2aqqat ba3d 3am; ma ymknsh n3emmo had tajriba 3la kol l-qora.
Government progress claim: official updates kay3ddo permits, construction starts, completed housing, aid and infrastructure; definitions, cut-off date and village distribution khas independent check.
supporting_evidence: Head of Government announcement dated 2023-09-20 sets 120bn MAD, 2024-2028 and 4.2m-person/6-province scope: https://www.cg.gov.ma/en/node/11397

World Bank approval dated 2023-12-14 documents $1bn Program-for-Results and resilience objectives: https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2023/12/14/world-bank-approves-1-billion-program-to-support-morocco-s-earthquake-recovery-and-resilience
World Bank project P178542 provides a durable place to follow results documents and implementation status: https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P178542
USGS event record independently establishes M6.8 event on 2023-09-08: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us7000kufc/executive
contradictory_evidence: Official milestones showing homes and infrastructure progressing contradict any blanket claim that nothing was rebuilt.
Independent field reporting of protests, delays and difficult interim shelter contradicts any blanket claim that reconstruction was complete or even across all villages.
The 120bn MAD envelope includes multiple sectors and five years; it contradicts a simplistic comparison treating all 120bn as housing money already spent.
A permit, a construction start, a completed structure and an occupied safe home are different outcomes; totals using different definitions can look contradictory without either being fabricated.
timeline: 2023-09-08: M6.8 earthquake strikes Al Haouz region (USGS event us7000kufc).
2023-09-20: government announces integrated 2024-2028 programme, 120bn MAD, aimed at 4.2m residents in six provinces/prefectures.
2023-12-14: World Bank approves $1bn recovery and resilience Program-for-Results.
2024-09: independent reporting records both official progress figures and complaints/protests by some survivors one year after the quake.
2026-09-02: dossier opened; current village-level completion, spending and appeals datasets still to be collected.

Reuters, field reporting on reconstruction and protests one year after quake, 2024-09, independent reporting; exact article permalink must be recovered before final citation, section index https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/
missing_evidence: Latest 2026 budget commitments versus cash disbursement, split by housing, roads, health, schools, water and agriculture.
Village-level table with eligible households, approvals, appeals, starts, completions, occupancy and completion definition.
Procurement notices, winning bidders, contract values, amendments, delays and beneficial-ownership information where legally public.
Inspection evidence for seismic compliance and treatment of local earthen architectural heritage.
Court of Accounts, inspectorate or lender verification findings, including adverse findings and corrective actions.
Exact Reuters article permalink and direct responses from programme officials and affected residents.
